title: North Quad
shortDescription: Four paths meet around a sundial that refuses to hurry.
longDescription:
Clipped grass makes a green square between the school's taller buildings. Four gravel paths meet at a sundial whose carved snail looks rather pleased with the speed of things.
Clockwork ticks from the east. A stray musical phrase drifts from the west, and the observatory's copper roof shines to the north like a leaf after rain.

fixtures.name: Snail Sundial
fixtures.examineDescription: The snail's shell is marked with the hours. Its inscription reads: 'Arriving thoughtfully is still arriving.' Someone has wedged a pebble beside the number four and labelled it 'Approximately biscuit time.' The shadow refuses to confirm this.
